items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Look at Ray Charles -- dances on the piano

ctx.x: What was a typical night like when you were at the Streets of Paris?

Average, just average. A lot of celebrities used to come in, you know. But it was such a big room. It was awful big even for the band upstairs it was pretty big. large. But the music lovers, when they came, they came to hear Fats -- So much talk -- Although the man is the most underrated person -- among the underrated that ever was ever alive. I mean too much talent, they got too much talent, they hurt their own selves, looks like. That kind of a thing is possible, you know, you can be too good for your own self.…

talking about the singing part - although he could sing the blues. Excellent. A lot of people didn't know that. He could sing the blues very good. I don't know why he didn't add 'em in there in our little program.
